messages:
Amir Haddad: Hi all, day 1 question — can I enable automatic forwarding from my work Gmail to my personal account while I'm waiting for the company VPN setup? Also: I do a lot of local Docker builds for side projects. Is running Docker on the loaner Mac allowed?

Diego Ramos: Welcome Amir! Do NOT enable email forwarding from work to personal — that violates data handling policy. If you need specific messages forwarded temporarily, people-ops can set an approved forwarding rule with logging. For Docker: allowed on company laptops but mount any credentials into containers from the company-approved secret store (Vault).

IT Support: Quick checklist for loaner usage: 1) MDM enrolled, 2) Full disk encryption active, 3) Company browser profile installed, 4) No personal cloud sync for work directories. If you run Docker, do not bind-mount ~/.ssh or cloud creds. Example: avoid `-v ~/.aws:/root/.aws`.

onboarding-bot: Reminder: "Security Basics" assigned to @Amir Haddad, due 14 days from start (1968500001). PhishSim cadence: randomized quarterly tests; remediation modules auto-assigned on failure.

Amir Haddad: Got it, thanks. If I accidentally clicked a simulated phishing link during the test, will my manager be notified? Also curious whether VPN conditional access blocks devices without disk encryption.

Diego Ramos: Manager notifications are not automatic for a single fail — the program focuses on remediation. Repeated fails may trigger a check-in. Conditional access: yes, the VPN gate enforces device posture. If MDM shows encryption disabled, Okta block rules will prevent VPN issuance until resolved.

IT Support: If you clicked a phish, finish the 5-10 minute micro-course as soon as possible. To prove FileVault status on mac: `sudo fdesetup status`. If it's "On", you're good. If not, contact IT and we'll push the encryption step.

Amir Haddad: One last ops question — can I request a hardware MFA token? I work on infra tooling and prefer a YubiKey.

Diego Ramos: Yes requestable via IT ticket with subject "YubiKey request". We'll provision and ship. In the meantime set up Okta Verify as primary.

Amir Haddad: Thanks — please add me to #sec-announcements and #new-joiners. Also appreciate the Docker guidance, I'll avoid mounting personal dirs. :thumbsup:
